note: 严格来说属于水晶残核(Crystal Hollows)而非矮人矿山,但按用户方案“主要出现场景”归入 Mining 大类。与其他 Emissary 共享台词模板。

messages.context: 无进行中委托时的开场白,要蘑菇
messages.text: I've heard I can find the best mushrooms here, and as the King's favorite emissary I will bring them to him!
messages.zh: 听说这里能找到最好的蘑菇,作为国王最喜欢的委托官,我会把它们带给他的!
messages.raw: §fI've heard I can find the best mushrooms here, and as the King's favorite emissary I will bring them to him!

messages.text: My standing as the King's favorite emissary is secured as soon as I bring these back home!
messages.zh: 只要我把这些带回去,我“国王最喜欢的委托官”这个位置就稳了!
messages.raw: §fMy standing as the King's favorite emissary is secured as soon as I bring these back home!

messages.context: 拒绝/取消委托时的台词,带威胁语气
messages.text: You are going to regret this!
